authors: Casalía B, Vilacoba E, Lavinia Oblanca PD, Tubaro PL, Barreira AS
title: UV sensitive vision in cardinals and tanagers is ubiquitous
why: Partial SWS1 opsin sequences across a broad sample of tanagers (Thraupidae); if Volatinia jacarina is in its species table it gives the grassquit's SWS1 type (UVS or VS), usable at grade g only since a gene predicts and does not measure a pigment. The CONICET record (hdl 11336/172826) is restricted and names no species.
get: journal via library (Taylor & Francis); the CONICET repository copy needs a request

authors: Lisney TJ, Iwaniuk AN, Kolominsky J, Wylie DR
title: Eye Morphology and Retinal Topography in Hummingbirds (Trochilidae: Aves)
why: The family survey of hummingbird eye size and ganglion-cell topography with acuity estimates; if Colibri is among its species it gives the violetears' own sharpness and area of sharpest vision. The author's page and BibTeX name no species and give no DOI.
get: journal via library (Karger, Brain Behav Evol 86: 176-190)
